assumptions._readme: All inputs of the cost model. Edit this file and re-run `python -m app.cli cost` to update every table. 'verified' says whether the number was checked against a public source on access_date; unverified values are illustrative estimates, NOT quotes.

workload.note: Same corpus, same queries and same payload (vector + chunk text + metadata) are assumed on both sides so the comparison is like-for-like. float32 vectors, no quantisation.

index_overhead_factor.note: HNSW graph links + bookkeeping, as a multiple of raw vector bytes. Estimate; Chroma/hnswlib overhead depends on M and ef settings.

ram_headroom_factor.note: headroom over the in-memory HNSW index for fragmentation and growth

baseline_ram_gib.note: OS + FastAPI + query-time embedding model (MiniLM + torch ~1 GiB)

disk_headroom_factor.note: SQLite metadata + HNSW segment files + compaction/snapshot scratch space

backup_copies.note: one full-size incremental snapshot chain retained

instances.name: m6i.large
instances.verified: third-party aggregator (doit.com), on-demand us-east-1, not aws.amazon.com

ebs_gp3_usd_per_gb_month.verified: weak: from a blog post, not aws.amazon.com - re-check

ops_usd_per_hour.note: loaded engineering cost; a pure assumption. Reported separately because it dominates at small scale.

managed_pinecone_serverless_standard.source: https://www.pinecone.io/pricing.md (Pricing Dimensions table) - accessed 2026-10-18; corroborated by third-party trackers
managed_pinecone_serverless_standard.read_unit_rule: 1 RU per GB of namespace size per query, minimum 0.25 RU (per Pinecone docs as summarised by third-party tracker flexprice.io; verify)
managed_pinecone_serverless_standard.write_unit_rule: ~1 WU per KB written, minimum 5 per request (third-party summary; verify). Batched upserts assumed.
managed_pinecone_serverless_standard.egress: 100 GB/month included on paid tiers; assumed not exceeded
managed_pinecone_serverless_standard.note: The low end of the published read/write price range is used. That favours the managed DB, so any saving shown for self-hosting is conservative. Pod-based pricing is not modelled: current pod prices could not be verified. Dedicated Read Nodes (an extra paid option) are not modelled.

assumptions.excluded_common_costs: Embedding generation (local MiniLM: $0 API cost, CPU time only), LLM inference (Groq tokens) and the application server are identical on both sides and therefore excluded from the comparison; they would be added equally to both columns.
